name: Tustin Counselor in Training (C.I.T.) Program
org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Help staff at the city summer day camps. You supervise kids, lead games and crafts, and enforce camp rules. You work in the sun and walk and run with the kids.
who_can_apply: High school students entering grades 9 to 12, or ages 14 to 17. You should enjoy working with people and follow rules.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The application calls it a non-paid position.
duration: 2 to 3 weeks, Monday to Friday, about 20 hours a week
deadline_text: The 2026 application was due May 1, 2026. Interviews were the week of May 4. Training was Saturday, May 30. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: You cannot apply online. Turn in your packet to the Parks and Recreation Department. The packet has the form, one reference and a personal statement. Questions: 714-573-3009 or tprd@tustinca.org.
notes: CITs at Camp Tustin volunteer 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. CITs at Little Folks volunteer 8:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. A training day is required.
